description: Category 2 Australian Defence Force Vehicle Bridges is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Main Roads Western Australia. RAV Network information periodically changes with additions or removal of data and users should confirm that information is current and accurate. The RAV Network Road Tables and RAV Mapping Tool can be found on the Main Roads Western Australia website, refer Hyperlink below. Coverage: Main Roads Western Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Main Roads Western Australia. Its tags are Australian Defence Force ADF, HVS, RAV. The portal shows 2026-08-23 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
